name: ChromaDB
author: Mox Neo
description: Reusable Pterodactyl egg for ChromaDB. Chroma listens on 127.0.0.1 inside the container; a pinned Caddy proxy on the allocation port requires a per-server random bearer token (Chroma 1.x has no built-in auth). Vectors under /home/container/data, backup script under /home/container/scripts.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data /mnt/server/scripts /mnt/server/backups /mnt/server/bin
apk add --no-cache curl tar >/dev/null

# Pinned Caddy reverse proxy: enforces the bearer token in front of Chroma
# (Chroma >= 1.0 has no built-in auth).
CADDY_VERSION=2.10.2
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64|amd64) A=amd64; SUM=747df7ee74de188485157a383633a1a963fd9233b71fbb4a69ddcbcc589ce4e2cc82dacf5dbbe136cb51d17e14c59daeb5d9bc92487610b0f3b93680b2646546 ;;
  aarch64|arm64) A=arm64; SUM=6ce061a690312ab38367df3c5d5f89a2e4a263e7300d300d87356211bb81e79b15933e6d6203e03fbf26f15cc0311f264805f336147dbdd24938d84b57a4421c ;;
  *) echo "[chromadb] unsupported arch: $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac
TGZ="/tmp/caddy_${CADDY_VERSION}_linux_${A}.tar.gz"
curl -fsSL "https://github.com/caddyserver/caddy/releases/download/v${CADDY_VERSION}/caddy_${CADDY_VERSION}_linux_${A}.tar.gz" -o "$TGZ"
echo "${SUM}  ${TGZ}" | sha512sum -c -
tar -xzf "$TGZ" -C /mnt/server/bin caddy
chmod 0755 /mnt/server/bin/caddy
rm -f "$TGZ"

# Random token, generated once. Never printed to the console.
if [ ! -s /mnt/server/.chroma-token ]; then
  ( umask 077; head -c 32 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n' > /mnt/server/.chroma-token )
fi
chmod 0600 /mnt/server/.chroma-token

cat > /mnt/server/Caddyfile <<'EOF'
{
	admin off
	auto_https off
	persist_config off
}
:{$SERVER_PORT} {
	@bearer header Authorization "Bearer {$CHROMA_TOKEN}"
	@xtoken header X-Chroma-Token "{$CHROMA_TOKEN}"
	handle @bearer {
		reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:{$CHROMA_INTERNAL_PORT}
	}
	handle @xtoken {
		reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:{$CHROMA_INTERNAL_PORT}
	}
	handle {
		header WWW-Authenticate "Bearer"
		respond "Unauthorized" 401
	}
}
EOF

cat > /mnt/server/start.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/container
mkdir -p data scripts backups
TOKEN_FILE=/home/container/.chroma-token
if [ -n "${CHROMA_AUTH_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
  if ! [[ "$CHROMA_AUTH_TOKEN" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._~-]{32,128}$ ]]; then
    echo "[chromadb] CHROMA_AUTH_TOKEN must be 32-128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ ~ -"
    exit 1
  fi
  ( umask 077; printf '%s' "$CHROMA_AUTH_TOKEN" > "$TOKEN_FILE" )
elif [ ! -s "$TOKEN_FILE" ]; then
  ( umask 077; head -c 32 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n' > "$TOKEN_FILE" )
fi
chmod 600 "$TOKEN_FILE"
CHROMA_TOKEN=$(cat "$TOKEN_FILE")
if ! [[ "$CHROMA_TOKEN" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._~-]{32,128}$ ]]; then
  echo "[chromadb] token in $TOKEN_FILE is invalid; delete it to regenerate"
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -x /home/container/bin/caddy ]; then
  echo "[chromadb] /home/container/bin/caddy missing; reinstall the server"
  exit 1
fi
export CHROMA_TOKEN
export CHROMA_INTERNAL_PORT=18000
if [ "$SERVER_PORT" = "$CHROMA_INTERNAL_PORT" ]; then export CHROMA_INTERNAL_PORT=18001; fi
unset CHROMA_AUTH_TOKEN

chroma run --host 127.0.0.1 --port "$CHROMA_INTERNAL_PORT" --path /home/container/data &
CHROMA_PID=$!
XDG_DATA_HOME=/home/container/.caddy XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/home/container/.caddy \
  /home/container/bin/caddy run --config /home/container/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile &
CADDY_PID=$!
unset CHROMA_TOKEN
stop() { kill -INT "$CADDY_PID" "$CHROMA_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap stop INT TERM
echo "[chromadb] token auth on port ${SERVER_PORT}; token file: /home/container/.chroma-token"
echo "[chromadb] ready"
set +e
wait -n "$CHROMA_PID" "$CADDY_PID"
rc=$?
stop
wait
exit "$rc"
EOF
chmod 0755 /mnt/server/start.sh

cat > /mnt/server/scripts/chromadb-backup.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
STAMP="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
OUT="/home/container/backups/chromadb-${STAMP}.tar.gz"
mkdir -p /home/container/backups
tar -C /home/container -czf "$OUT" data
echo "backup_created=$OUT"
EOF
chmod 0755 /mnt/server/scripts/chromadb-backup.sh
echo 'ChromaDB install prep complete.'

variables.name: Auth token (optional override)
variables.description: Leave blank (recommended): a random token is generated on install and stored in /home/container/.chroma-token (mode 0600, never printed to the console). If set, must be 32-128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ ~ - and replaces the stored token on next start.
